description: This file implements an adapter for the OpenAI Realtime API for a language model interface within the Pipecat framework. It provides classes and functions to convert messages, handle context, and interface with the OpenAI Realtime API, supporting function calling and message formatting.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMAdapter
classes.description: A class that acts as an adapter for OpenAI Realtime API, handling message formatting, context management, and function schema conversions for the Pipecat framework.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: A TypedDict specifying the parameters for invoking the OpenAI Realtime LLM API, including system instructions, messages, and tools.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: A dataclass used internally within the adapter to store messages in the OpenAI-realtime-specific format along with optional system instructions.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns the string identifier used in message instances for OpenAI Realtime.

methods.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Prepares and returns the parameters required to invoke the OpenAI Realtime API based on the provided LLM context.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context)
methods.description: Returns a sanitized, formatted list of messages suitable for secure logging, with sensitive info truncated or removed.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal LLM context messages into OpenAI-specific formatted messages, handling special cases like system and user messages.

methods.name: events.ConversationItem _from_universal_context_message( self, message: LLMContextMessage )
methods.description: Converts a single universal LLM context message into an OpenAI ConversationItem.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_openai_realtime_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Transforms a FunctionSchema object into a format compatible with OpenAI Realtime function call specifications.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a ToolsSchema into a list of function definitions suitable for OpenAI Realtime API.

ctags.name: to_provider_tools_format
ctags.pattern: /^    def to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
